subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should ordinary `write` expose append as optional `append?: boolean`, or should OpenClaw require a `mode` field or separate append tool before this data-loss fix lands?
rationale: The implementation is default-preserving and technically plausible, but it expands the model-facing tool contract and backend write operation contract, which is a maintainer-owned product/API decision.

options.title: Accept `append?: boolean`
options.body: Approve the boolean append flag as the smallest backwards-compatible extension and land after exact-head owner review remains clean.

options.title: Request a different API shape
options.body: Ask the contributor to switch to a `mode` field or dedicated append tool if maintainers want stronger semantic separation from destructive overwrite.

options.title: Pause for a replacement branch
options.body: Keep this PR open but defer landing only if another candidate proves the same behavior with a narrower, safer surface.

recommendation.title: Accept `append?: boolean`
recommendation.body: Approve the boolean append flag as the smallest backwards-compatible extension and land after exact-head owner review remains clean.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent agent runtime/tool work makes them the best available owner for the model-facing API boundary decision.
